supervision: Only text/meaning and initial lexicon; no fold identity, heldout labels, state/action/order annotations enter fit. All systems retrained on the exact same 432 training pairs within a fold, never old fully trained weights.
data: Original 576/192/192 partitions reused. Remove all 144 training rows of one order*polarity combination per fold, covering both modalities. Evaluation/development retain48 withheld-combination and144 seen-combination rows. Each evaluated component and lexical token is present in restricted training. Not a new project-blind corpus.
architecture: Content-role order and marker gaps are a designed decomposition. Train-only categorical information-gain selection finds partial context masks. Phase correlation performs runtime correspondence retrieval. No claim all learning machinery is SS.
gates: Per fold/seed: six heldout/seen read/generate/roundtrip buckets exact>=0.98; no wrong accepted reading/output; invalid text/packet accept=0; full_context and old_ss seen read/generate>=0.98 and heldout drop>=0.50 in both stages; no_learning accepts none. 13*4*4=208 plus full-training regression=209 checks. Table references and low-dimensional stress are non-gating and reported in full.
references: Partial-context ordinary matching with exactly the same learned dependencies/components, and old whole-shape/prefix tables. One run per fold, no artificial code-seed repetitions; no matched speed or byte budgets.
